summary: Configured node1 with 512 MiB of disk-backed swap at priority 100. It activates from /etc/fstab during boot and remained healthy after a verified node restart. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were preserved.
actions_performed: Created /swapfile as a fully allocated 536,870,912-byte file with mode 0600 and SELinux type swapfile_t.
Initialized and activated the swap at priority 100.
Added a persistent /etc/fstab entry with pri=100 and validated the file.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the system recovered to running state and swap was automatically activated from /etc/fstab.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: The swapfile is 536,870,912 bytes with 1,048,576 allocated 512-byte blocks; it persisted across restart with secure ownership and SELinux labeling.
Both before and after restart, /swapfile is active with 536,866,816 usable bytes and priority 100. It is the only active swap entry.
The validated fstab entry uses defaults,pri=100. After restart, systemd reports swapfile.swap active, generated from /etc/fstab, and the current-boot journal records successful activation.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 match before and after the change.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 9bdcc129-3d25-48ff-ad64-56be332fb91e; the native reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 7e7d3f68-355d-4eb0-9266-78891270078b; system state returned to running with no failed units and persistent swap active.
